collection.description: An adult villager realizes they have romantic feelings for a friend of the same sex.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager), an adult villager, realizes they have romantic feelings for (friend) of the same sex.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (friend) returns the affection, and they begin courting.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (friend) does not share the feelings but responds warmly.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They discover their bond feels more like family.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (relative) listens thoughtfully and asks what support would help.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (villager) becomes more certain of their feelings.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) decides no confession is needed to value the friendship.
